card.name: Unrelated scattered spots in drug text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on scattered spots such as the middle of chemical names, a space before a number, and 'has' or 'have' after a drug name.

modes.label: Inside chemical names
modes.description: Partway through a long chemical name such as diethylhexyl phthalate or polyethylene glycol.

modes.label: Has/have after a subject
modes.description: The verb 'has' or 'have' after a drug name or warning heading, before 'been reported' or 'been established'.
modes.example: Acute Gallbladder Disease :<< Has>> been reported in clinical trials.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space just before a number such as 20% or 8000.
